title: Warm Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with warm spices and tender chicken, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wine and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew, chicken broth, and tomatoes.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
